newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Monday closed down by 0.51 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 612.66 from 615.81 on Friday.
Trade volume was 456,000 dinars ($470,000) against 690,000 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT was down 1.34 dinar to 43.18 dinars. BTEI bank down 0.67 dinar to 21.76 dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank was up 0.96 dinar to 57 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
